fact: The ECA Director General told Shega the Authority had received about 10 requests to transfer data abroad and had approved them as a temporary measure, and officials previewed a forthcoming registration portal for data controllers and processors at a workshop co-hosted with Huawei; the article records no sanction or published count of decisions, noting that as of March 2025 no ECA enforcement actions or guidelines had been publicized.

Techhive Advisory says Ethiopia's Personal Data Protection Proclamation was published in the Federal Negarit Gazette on 24 July 2024, bringing it into effect, and that Articles 18-21 make international transfers depend on an Authority adequacy decision, explicit consent of the data subject, necessity, or public registry purposes, with sensitive data transfers needing the Authority's prior authorisation.

The law firm Haymanot & Advocates says Directive SBB/94/2025 makes transfers abroad of non-customer data by banks conditional on National Bank of Ethiopia prior written approval, disclosure of destinations, adequate protection in the receiving jurisdiction and service level agreements.
